title: Numerals in full
description: Collective numerals, numbers with groups of men, and numbers in every case.

blocks.text: Polish numerals are among the hardest parts of the grammar. Collective numerals (dwoje, troje, pięcioro) are used for children, young animals, mixed-gender groups and plural-only nouns: dwoje dzieci, troje drzwi. With groups that include men, numbers have special forms: dwaj bracia or dwóch braci (two brothers). From five upwards, the noun goes into the genitive plural and the verb into the neuter singular: pięciu studentów przyszło. Numerals also decline with the case of the phrase: z pięcioma kolegami (with five friends).

blocks.note: Also correct: Dwóch braci mieszka w Gdańsku.
Genitive plural noun, neuter singular verb.

blocks.translation: I met up with five friends.

blocks.text: Urodziłam się w tysiąc dziewięćset dziewięćdziesiątym roku.
blocks.note: Only the last part of a year is an ordinal that declines.
